title: Knit --json failure
description: What every `--json` command prints on stdout when it fails, as one JSON document. The process also prints a human `Error:` line on stderr and exits non-zero. Fields may be added over time.

kind.description: What went wrong, for a host to branch on. New kinds can appear: treat an unknown kind like `other`.

message.description: The same explanation as the stderr `Error:` line, on one line, for people.
